variants.name: Slugs
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to a slug, a single incredibly heavy and dense projectile.
Increased projectile speed, massively increased damage, improved damage to the head, and greatly tightened choke.

A 30-06 conversion kit for the AK-12/76, with a rifled barrel and bolt capable of handling the new round. A popular sporting cartridge, the 30-06 round packs a powerful punch at all ranges.

Very high damage with a below average rate of fire.

variants.name: Flechette
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to flechettes, small dart projectiles specially desgined to defeat soft body armor.
Great for enemies hiding behind cover but less effective against limbs.

variants.name: Rubber Pellets
variants.info: Shotgun shells loaded with rubber buckshot. Less than lethal isn't the same as non-lethal, and you're about to prove that...

variants.name: .410 Bore
variants.info:
A conversion kit for the .410 shotgun round using a modified trigger group designed to fire in two-round bursts.

Reduced pellet count, but with increased damage per pellet, magazine capacity, and overall rate of fire.

variants.name: Birdshot
variants.info:
Changes your shot load to birdshot: a large quantity of small pellets that are great for hunting waterfowl and grouse -- but significantly less great at dealing with modern body armor.

Significantly reduced penetration and performance when hitting the torso, but significantly more pellets.
